source: BC Wildfire Service, as of Aug 25 (4pm update)
delta: +150 ha vs Aug 23 estimate — growth remains slow
deltaNote: Down to 6 evacuation orders and 10 evacuation alerts (from 8 orders/13 alerts); all Peachland-area alerts fully rescinded, though the Faulder evacuation order remains where dozens of homes were destroyed. 322 firefighters assigned with 24-hour coverage; warmer, drier conditions expected to raise visible flame/smoke

label: Pear Lake Fire Size (Cariboo, BC)
source: BC Wildfire Service, as of Aug 24
delta: Unchanged vs Aug 21 estimate — size steady after weekend rain
deltaNote: Now the season's second-largest wildfire; 476 firefighters, 89 structure-protection personnel, 120 heavy equipment units and 21 helicopters deployed. Village of Clinton rescinded most evacuation alerts but some remain due to flood risk; a warming/drying trend could increase fire activity
